digest: Mapped stop, cancellation, terminal-summary implementations and found no unit-test files.

implementationMap.component: Workflow stop detection and signal registry
implementationMap.evidence: launchSignals is keyed by workflowRunPath; checks registered aborted signals and readWorkflowStopIntent; polling and throw paths are separate.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Monitor catches disk-read errors, throwIfWorkflowStopRequested propagates them. Poll default is 200ms with a 1ms minimum. dispose only clears the interval.

implementationMap.evidence: createWorkflowStopRequestedError sets name WorkflowStopRequested and message workflow stop requested for <runId>.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Classifier accepts the required name but also accepts any Error whose message starts with workflow stop requested.

implementationMap.evidence: Checks AbortError objects, cancelled flags, selected error/reason fields, and recursively parses JSON text in content entries with parsed !== value.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Recognizes aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR, but also cancelled, timeout, and boolean cancelled markers; JSON content is recursively inspected with a self-reference guard.

implementationMap.evidence: Maps completed plus degradation to completed_degraded; reads dynamic control.json and falls back to completed_without_semantic_result; sums retry attempts across tasks.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Public summary exposes outputRetryAttempts and launchRetries, while SPEC names launchRetryAttempts.

implementationMap.evidence: package.json defines only a typecheck script, and no test files are present in the repository file list.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: No located unit-test evidence covers the S, C, or T requirements.

unmappedAreas: store.js and types.js are referenced by src but intentionally absent from this excerpt; their contracts cannot be inspected.
No unit-test files or test script were found for Q1 evidence.
notes: This stage maps implementation evidence only; it does not conclude specification conformance.
